newsitem.title: JAPAN: MOF asks Ogawa, Daichu to improve business-sources.
newsitem.headline: MOF asks Ogawa, Daichu to improve business-sources.

text.p: The Ministry of Finance (MOF) has ordered Ogawa Securities Co and Daichu Securities Co, financially troubled brokerages based in Osaka, to improve their operations, industry sources said on Monday.
The securities houses, which are both unlisted, submitted restructuring plans to the ministry in April but MOF ordered them to upgrade the plans, the industry sources said.
MOF, Daichu and Ogawa all declined to comment.
If the brokerages cannot comply with the order, their survival in the securities industry could be in doubt, the industry sources said.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun business daily said in its evening edition on Monday that both brokerages were asking Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd, which is their major shareholder, for support to restructure their businesses.
But Yamaichi is wary of providing the requested help as it believes Daichu and Ogawa themselves have not done enough to restructure their businesses, the paper said.
